note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; terminal commands are typed and run for real. $env:MG_DEV_URL (DEV org URL) and the other MG_* variables are set by the owner as user environment variables on the laptop and never appear on screen.
prepare: Read-Host 'Owner: DEV region supports prompts; episodes 1-9 are in DEV; for the app/credits screens a pay-as-you-go plan (resource group rg-mglab-powerapps-10) is linked to a production or sandbox environment (NOT today). Press Enter to record the prompt and solution screens only'
Read-Host 'Owner: Return check screen and returnLoan flow exist in Equipment Desk (phone) per demo.md step 4. Press Enter'

screens.name: prompt-builder
steps: AI hub > Prompts > New custom prompt, name ReturnNoteTriage (or open the saved one)
Paste src/prompt/return-note-triage.prompt.txt, replace the {{Return note}} marker with a Text input named Return note
Output: Text. Test the golden notes: the cracked-screen note, the missing-charger note and the injection note, each answered with JSON
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: return-check
steps: Play Equipment Desk (phone) (browser play mode or Power Apps mobile) > Open loans > CT-0043 > Returned
Type 'Crack across the top right corner of the screen, still turns on and works.' and tap Check with AI
Show the suggestion line (Damaged) and the picker on In repair, then Mark returned
Unhappy paths: note 'ok' keeps the button off; a vague note gives the Information notification
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
any real mail domain: only the fictional *.demo@contoso.com addresses may stay

screens.name: solution-prompt
steps: Solutions > Equipment Desk > Add existing > AI models > ReturnNoteTriage
Show the AI model in the component list
Open Managed properties: Allow customizations off
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: credits-admin
steps: Show the pay-as-you-go plan and the credits used by the session (it can lag a day; or Azure Cost Management)
Alternative: the app's 'isn't available right now' notification when there is no capacity
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
billing plan name, subscription and resource group names

teardown: Write-Host 'Reminder: remove DEV from the billing plan and delete the plan; delete resource group rg-mglab-powerapps-10 in the Azure portal (az group delete -n rg-mglab-powerapps-10); delete the prompt ReturnNoteTriage; reset CT-0043 (open loan, Notes Charger missing, device On loan).'
needs: paid:Copilot Credits (pay-as-you-go plan, a few euros)
blocked: return-check and credits-admin cannot be recorded: running a prompt in an app needs Copilot Credits (pay-as-you-go plan or capacity) on a production or sandbox environment, which the lab does not have (DEV has no plan; AI Builder trials and seeded credits ended 1 Nov 2026). prompt-builder and solution-prompt can be recorded (testing in the prompt builder is free).
